notes: The page is the LBCC-GE (Plan A, local associate-degree GE) pattern, not the CSU GE-Breadth certificate named in the request; the text itself says students transferring to CSU/UC should follow Cal-GETC. Reviewer should confirm the correct source page.
Page footnote cites the 2025-2026 LBCC-GE Checklist (published June 2025), not the 2026-2027 catalog year.

No total for this award is stated; the text gives 25 GE units for the A.A. and 19 for the A.S. degree, which were not recorded as the award total. ge_pattern left null because this page is itself a GE pattern rather than a degree naming one.
The Area 1A tab is labeled 'Area 1 (1A/1B): English Composition, Oral Communication and' (truncated) but lists English composition courses; recorded as Area 1A: English Composition.
Stated minimums ('Minimum 3 units', '3 units minimum') recorded as stated min 3 with max null.

Honors twins printed on separate rows (e.g., ENGL C1000 / ENGL C1000H, MATH C2210 / C2210H, STAT C1000 / C1000H) were recorded as one entry with the honors course as alternative; enhanced versions (ENGL C1000E, STAT C1000E) kept as separate catalog-addition entries.
Catalog prints ARTH C1100/C1100H, ARTH C1200/C1200H and CDEV C1000 with a space; matched to closed-list ARTHC1100, ARTHC1200, CDEVC1000.
LING 1H, LING 3H, PHIL 1H, PHIL 10H, SPAN 1H, SPAN 2H appear as honors alternatives but are not in the closed list (catalog additions).

Area 4 course list is cut off mid-entry at 'POLSC 10 Introduction'; remaining Area 4 courses and the course lists for Areas 5 (Natural Sciences), 6 (Ethnic Studies), 7 (Lifelong Understanding and Self Development) and 8 (American Institutions and Ideals) are not in the text, so those blocks were not recorded.

PHIL 2 and PHIL 10/10H appear in both Area 3 and Area 4; the catalog states a course may satisfy only one area. Cross-listed courses (ECON 5 = GEOG 5, HUMAN 1/1H = SOCSC 1/1H, HUMAN 7 = SOCSC 7, PH 10 = PSYCH 10) may be used in only one subject area.
No program learning outcomes or careers are printed for this award; 'Careers' appears only in the site footer menu.
Read in 2 parts, because one reply could not hold the whole record.
Reviewer: part 2 names blocks part 1 does not: 'Area 1 (1A/1B): English Composition, Oral Communication and Critical Thinking' (kept beside 'Area 1A: English Composition')
